featureLines: WyreStorm provides solutions for today’s demanding LECTURING spaces.

The very core of WyreStorm transmission, we've embraced HDBaseT technology since 2010. We're now taking the capabilities of HDBaseT to the next level and supporting video bandwidths in excess of 10Gbps with our lossless compression technology built in to out H2X matrix platform. The RXV-70-4K will output HDMI content at up to 2160p 4:4:4/60.

As space between displays and the wall they're mounted to reduces, finding a receiver to fit in this gap can be hard to find. But just because this receiver packs a punch doesn't mean it can't deliver the small footprint that you've come to expect. It also ships complete with all the accessories needed to help the integrator complete the install discreetly and efficiently.
For use exclusively with H2XC matrix and TX-H2X-VLC modular card. Not compatible with MXV matrix range.
Compatible with HDR standards including HDR-10, HDR-10+, HLG and Dolby Vision (Dolby Vision supported up to 30Hz)
Class A HDBaseT supporting the transmission of video, multichannel audio, Ethernet, bidirectional control and PoH
Bidirectional IR supported with both IR TX & RX ports
Supports Ethernet pass-through from matrix (Class A HDBaseT transmission only)
Wall mounting brackets and IR accessories included
HDCP 2.2 | EDID | CEC | DVI-D supported with adapter (not included)
Supported file types: jpg, jpeg, png, txt, pdf, doc, docx
